back: Natural: lightning, soil bacteria. Man-made: engines, power stations (N₂ + O₂ → 2NO at high temperature).
2CO + 2NO → 2CO₂ + N₂ on Pt/Pd/Rh; hydrocarbons oxidised to CO₂ + H₂O.
NOₓ + unburnt hydrocarbons + sunlight → ozone and PAN (peroxyacetyl nitrate): eye and lung irritants.
NO₂ + SO₂ → NO + SO₃; NO + ½O₂ → NO₂ (regenerated); SO₃ + H₂O → H₂SO₄.
Dissolves limestone (CaCO₃ + 2H⁺ → Ca²⁺ + H₂O + CO₂), harms lakes and fish, damages trees.
Nitrates leached → algal bloom → decay by bacteria uses O₂ → fish die.
Kills micro-organisms and acts as an antioxidant (reducing agent); used in dried fruit, juices, wine.
Rain with pH below about 5.6, made acidic by dissolved SO₂ and NO₂ (sulfuric and nitric acids).
